visual_requirements.description: Muscular male with black jackal head and pointed ears; two arms, opaque clothes; golden scales with white feather.
Physical weighing ritual, no invented magic.

depicted_variant: Black jackal-headed Anubis adjusting golden weighing scales in Hall of Truth.
aura: Fair divine judgment(c19) expressed through huge close golden scales and feather(c15), black jackal head(c02).
artistic_choices: Opaque linen tunic and wrap cover torso and legs.
Weighing heart represented by small symbolic terracotta heart-shaped weight, no exposed anatomy or gore.
Unlettered dark Hall of Truth stone with warm lamp light, no magical aura.
Close camera magnifies sacred scales without inventing giant Anubis.

prompts.A:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Anubis, Egyptian jackal-headed divine judge and guide of dead.
ANATOMY: muscular man with ONE black jackal head, two pointed ears, two eyes, two human arms and legs; fully opaque black and parchment linen ceremonial tunic and long wrap cover torso and legs. Large clear GOLDEN balance scales, WHITE feather on one pan and small symbolic terracotta heart-shaped weight on other, no tissue [anubis-c02,c15].
POWER: careful physical weighing of symbolic heart against white feather, sacred judgment and guidance, NO invented magical effects [anubis-c15,c19].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle at scale pan, jackal face and gold beam dominant; no giant stature.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one oil-flame source, warm gold rim, deep shadows and fine tomb dust.
SURFACE: short dense black canine fur, hammered golden scales, dry linen, ancient rough stone.
SETTING: Hall of Truth in Egyptian afterlife, plain unlettered columns [anubis-c08].
MOOD: overwhelming sacred judgment, severe protective authority, never ordinary animal or decorative statue.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no hieroglyphs/pseudo-lettering ANYWHERE including clothing/scales/walls, no text/logos/borders/watermarks, no extra limbs, no film/game/comic designs, no nudity/gore, no generic aura/neon/ribbons.
MOMENT: Anubis leans toward viewer and adjusts scale beam delicately with one hand while raising other pan, jackal eyes focused down, white feather clearly isolated against black stone. Front three-quarter towering close framing.
